newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline resists NYMEX fall on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline resists NYMEX fall on tight supply.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady despite a sharp fall in NYMEX futures, partly because trade died towards the close and partly because European supply was tight, particularly for high octane grades, traders said.
Premium unleaded barges traded early at $233-234 per tonne fob Rotterdam and were talked around that level later.

A Polish buyer was looking for a leaded 94 RON cargo while high octane demand was reported in France and the UK. Superplus cargoes were sold into the Med at Eurograde barges +$30 cif Med, while superplus cargoes fob NWE were valued at $14 premium to Eurograde barges. -- Tom Ashby, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8145
